zh.summary: 内置官方 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1（官方预发布候选）。
highlights: 将运行时、官方 tag 与提交、npm integrity 和许可清单锁定到 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1。
历史会话兼容继续绑定精确摘要；独立 staged app 已实跑读取、AgentLoop 继续、保存重开与中断恢复，最终成品仍需完整 CI。
待发布的默认图片查看器 0.1.4 与会话管理 1.5.3 声明兼容 alpha.1、rc.2 和 0.2.0-rc.1。
官方插件管理页的新版本继续提供 Portable 刷新与更新入口，刷新锚点按上游精确匹配。
upgradeNotes: 可从 0.7.x 通过应用内更新或下载完整新包升级；会话、设置、凭据与插件预计保留（待 G1 证实）。官方 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 是预发布候选，不是正式上游内核。
knownIssues: 完整多屏与混合 DPI 硬件组合、物理断电恢复尚未完成本版本专项验收。
官方自动化任务 Schedule 作为可选插件包提供，Portable 默认 profile 未启用。

en.summary: Bundle official DSH 0.2.0-rc.1, an upstream release candidate.
highlights: Pin the runtime, official tag and commit, npm integrity, and license manifest to DSH 0.2.0-rc.1.

Keep historical-session compatibility bound to exact digests; read, AgentLoop continuation, persisted reopen, and interrupted recovery passed in an independent staged app, while the final package still requires full CI.
Pending publication, default Image Viewer 0.1.4 and Session Manager 1.5.3 declare compatibility with alpha.1, rc.2, and 0.2.0-rc.1.
The newer official plugin manager page continues to provide Portable refresh and update entry points, using an exact upstream refresh anchor.
upgradeNotes: Upgrade from 0.7.x through the in-app updater or a complete package. Sessions, settings, credentials, and plugins are expected to be retained (pending G1 verification). Official DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 is a prerelease candidate, not a final upstream core.
knownIssues: The complete multi-monitor/mixed-DPI hardware matrix and physical power-loss recovery have not completed qualification for this version.
Official Schedule automation is supplied as an optional plugin bundle and is not enabled in the Portable default profile.
